pr238.head: b9da533297d3d232060883b53d1f8117d9f814eb
pr238.positive: Multi-unit binding/state, inspection workflow, explicit role boundary and honest NOT_VERIFIED evidence. Functional commit d89f99fb is separable from generated graph commit b9da5332.
sourceEvidence: TechnicianDispatch.Tick advances RECEIVED/TRAVELLING/WORKING by 4/35/20 elapsed seconds; Complete directly calls Target.ApplyReplacement without a technician actor, physical arrival/work evidence, custody or common executor result. This remains true in child PR240; its added Lerp body does not authorize real work.

At this parent revision TutorialSession.Rewind only clears procedure flags/findings, leaving requested dispatch/timer alive. Child PR240 already adds a guard refusing rewind after dispatch request and inverse effects before that; do not report the parent-only defect as still unchanged in child.

TutorialCarryoverStore is a separate JSON store and ApplyCarryover writes facility state directly. Current SqliteProvider now supports macOS/Windows-x64 native loading; Windows Player qualification remains unverified. Migrate semantic persistence/isolation rather than extend two independent state authorities.
712 files/+1171653 lines, including separate 683-file generated Graphify commit that the author explicitly offers to split; functional review should not import unrelated cache churn.
pr238.independentReviewer: Luna/high: request changes; concrete timed-completion and parent rewind findings. No new test/build run claimed.
pr238.candidateDisposition: Request changes and focused resubmission; preserve multi-binding/procedure ideas, adapt action/rewind/persistence to common runtime, split generated artifacts. No safe self-contained commit ready for merge as-is.

pr240.head: 7b87264bccc6a4bbed276d2827d84543ffadf59a
pr240.positive: Actual tag orientation/material/collider fixes, explicit verdict choice/per-unit state, rewind fixes, bootstrap entry, measured collider-based placement, frame evidence for tag and a single-concourse passenger walk. Later commits improve upon the stale initial PR description; credit those fixes.
sourceEvidence: StationNavigation.TryPlan accepts nearest endpoint inside SnapExtent(1,2,1) without checking distance to requested goal. PassengerAgent declares ARRIVED at the last corner using horizontal distance, not original Destination.

Root executed the actual Detour query plus PR endpoint/arrival calculations in local Unity on synthetic continuous geometry: requested (16,4.5,2), accepted endpoint (16,3.08281231,2), complete polygon route, ARRIVED calculation true despite 1.41718769m original-goal error > .6m arrival radius. This is a scene-free algorithm reproduction, not a full PR scene/OS-input run.

PassengerAgent owns a parallel Transform-driven NPC not connected to WorldSession actor registry/receipts, and StationNavigation/StationNavigationBaker create a second path backend. Baker deliberately limits one player-centered concourse band and warns/skips unreadable meshes. This does not implement the current shared multi-floor contract.
TechnicianPresence Lerp follows dispatch stage timing; WORKING snaps body to work spot. It does not fix parent timer-authorized replacement.

Tutorial changes depend on PR238 runtime shape; whole commits also change large serialized FpsStation content. Useful tag/input/placement fixes require a narrowed PR rather than blindly cherry-picking the mixed commits.
pr240.independentReviewer: Luna/high: request changes for false arrival; reusable entry/tag/placement concepts with parent and validation dependencies. Historical receipts are bounded, not fresh integrated proof.
pr240.candidateDisposition: Request changes and split presentation/input/procedure/placement improvements from parallel NPC/navigation. Adapt useful slices to current shared runtime and fix endpoint validation before merge.

disposition.instructions: Independently recommend the disposition of this pinned PR from the supplied evidence, user intent, useful scope and merge gates. Root candidate is advice, not an instruction. Do not merge unverified incompatible gameplay or reject useful work merely for age.

criteria.merge_as_is: Accept the complete pinned PR only if it satisfies current direction, behavioral correctness and merge gates without bypass.
criteria.request_changes_and_split: Keep useful work open, request concrete fixes/migration and smaller independent PRs; do not merge the present mixed revision.
criteria.close_and_reject: Close the PR as fundamentally unsuitable with no worthwhile adapted scope; stronger than requesting changes.
